common.head:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single game sprite for a vertical Space Invaders style arcade shooter. It will be shown small, so it must read at low resolution.
Reference images: the first attached image is the art style sheet. The second attached image is a crop of this exact character from that sheet. Redraw that character as one standalone sprite in the same style.
common.style: Style/medium: chibi kawaii pixel art matching the reference sheet: crisp hard-edged square pixels, clean dark outline around the whole silhouette, the same saturated palette and shading, big glossy anime eyes.
common.framing: Composition/framing: exactly one character, centered, front-facing, the whole sprite inside the canvas with a wide empty margin on every side, nothing cropped, square canvas.
common.constraints: Constraints: the background is one flat solid pure green #00FF00 filling the entire canvas edge to edge. No gradient, no stars, no space backdrop, no glow, no bloom, no aura, no drop shadow, no ground, no motion lines. The sprite itself uses no green at all. Hard pixel edges with no anti-aliasing against the background.
common.avoid: Avoid: text, labels, watermark, signature, frame or border, a second character, extra sparkles floating around the sprite, any part of the other sheet characters.

characters.request:
Primary request: the blue mecha-jet player ship from the sheet, seen from above, nose pointing straight UP at the top of the canvas, symmetric left and right. Swept white-and-blue wings with pink trim, two side engine pods, a round glass canopy in the middle with a cute chibi pilot girl (light blue hair, big blue eyes) visible inside. The engines end in dark nozzles: draw NO exhaust flames, no thruster fire and no engine trails below the ship.
Color palette: royal blue, white, light gray, hot pink accents, small cyan details, dark navy outline.

Primary request: a tiny companion option drone that flies beside the player ship. A small round white-and-blue pod with two little cat-ear fins on top, one big cute glowing cyan visor eye, a pink stripe, and a short gun nub pointing up. Very simple and chunky, few details, it must read at only 14 pixels wide. It matches the player ship's colors.
Color palette: white, royal blue, cyan glow, hot pink accent, dark navy outline.

Primary request: the enemy 'Pico Drone' from the sheet: a floating chibi robot-girl head with light blue-white hair, oversized sparkling blue eyes, a cute :3 mouth, a white helmet with two antennae, and big round cyan headphone pods on both sides, two small hover thrusters below. Bold simple silhouette, wider than tall, oversized eyes, few colors, thick dark outline, so it reads at 28 pixels wide.
Color palette: white, pale blue hair, cyan glow lights, blue eyes, peach skin, dark navy outline.

Primary request: the enemy 'Gunner Girl' from the sheet: a floating chibi girl head with bright pink twin tails sticking out to both sides, a dark purple tech visor pushed up on her forehead, oversized sparkling pink eyes, a cute :3 mouth, two small horn-like hair clips, and two small pink thruster pods below. Bold simple silhouette, wider than tall, oversized eyes, few colors, thick dark outline, so it reads at 30 pixels wide.
Color palette: hot pink hair, magenta eyes, dark purple visor, black clips, peach skin, dark navy outline.

Primary request: the enemy 'Bulwark' from the sheet: a floating chibi girl head with lavender hair inside a heavy purple armored mecha helmet with a crest horn on top, big blocky purple shoulder cannon pods on both sides, oversized sparkling violet eyes and a cute :3 mouth. Heavy, chunky, armored, wider than tall, bold simple silhouette, few colors, thick dark outline, so it reads at 30 pixels wide.
Color palette: deep purple and violet armor, lavender hair, pink-violet glow accents, small gold trim, peach skin, dark navy outline.

Primary request: the enemy 'Kamikaze Kitsune' from the sheet: a floating chibi fox girl head with orange hair, two big pointed fox ears with white fluff on top, fluffy fox tails peeking out at both sides, oversized sparkling amber eyes, an open happy fanged smile, a small headset, and two round orange side thruster pods below. Bold simple silhouette, wider than tall, oversized eyes, few colors, thick dark outline, so it reads at 30 pixels wide.
Color palette: bright orange, cream white fluff, amber eyes, dark gray thruster rims, peach skin, dark navy outline.

Primary request: the boss 'Crimson Seraph' from the sheet: a chibi angel mecha girl with long pale pink hair, a gold crown crest, a halo drawn as a solid red pixel ring above her head (no glow), and huge spread mechanical wings made of red and white blade feathers with gold trim. She wears a fully covered red armored chest plate and a full red-and-black armored bodysuit with armored boots, modest, no cleavage, no bare midriff. Arms open, floating, symmetric, wings spread wide so the whole sprite is wider than tall.
Color palette: crimson red, white and pale pink, gold trim, black joints, ruby gems, peach skin, dark outline.

Primary request: the boss 'Void Empress' from the sheet: a chibi empress girl with very long flowing lavender hair, a spiky black-and-gold crown, a thin purple halo ring behind her head drawn as solid pixels (no glow), two dark purple orbs with gold rings floating at her sides, and a long high-necked black, purple and white gown with full-coverage bodice and long wide sleeves, modest, no cleavage, no bare midriff. Arms open, floating, symmetric, roughly as wide as tall.
Color palette: deep purple, black, lavender, white, gold trim, violet gems, peach skin, dark outline.

Primary request: the boss 'Crimson Seraph' from the sheet: a chibi angel mecha girl with long pale pink hair, a gold crown crest, a halo drawn as a solid red pixel ring above her head (no glow), and huge spread mechanical wings made of red and white blade feathers with gold trim. Outfit must be fully modest: a solid smooth high-collared red breastplate that covers her from the neck down, with no cutout, no window and no cleavage; a long armored skirt of overlapping red and white plates that reaches her armored boots, with no bare thighs, no leotard and no bare midriff. Only her face and hands show skin. Arms open, floating, symmetric, wings spread wide so the whole sprite is wider than tall.
Color palette: crimson red, white and pale pink, gold trim, black joints, ruby gems, peach skin, dark outline.

Primary request: the boss 'Void Empress' from the sheet: a chibi empress girl with very long flowing lavender hair, a spiky black-and-gold crown, a thin purple halo ring behind her head drawn as solid pixels (no glow), and two dark purple orbs with gold rings floating at her sides. Outfit must be fully modest: a closed high-necked black and purple gown whose solid bodice covers her from the collar down, with no neckline opening, no cutout, no cleavage and no slit; long wide white-and-purple sleeves; the skirt is one continuous closed panel to the floor. Only her face and hands show skin. Arms open, floating, symmetric, roughly as wide as tall.
Color palette: deep purple, black, lavender, white, gold trim, violet gems, peach skin, dark outline.

Use case: image edit of a game sprite.
Edit target: the attached pixel art sprite of the Void Empress.
Change only the bodice: fill the open chest window below the collar and the V-shaped slit at the waist with solid black-purple gown fabric, so the dress is fully closed from the collar to the floor with no skin and no cleavage showing on the torso. Keep the dress a continuous closed panel.
Keep everything else exactly unchanged: same pose, same face, hair, crown, halo, orbs, chains, sleeves, colors, pixel size, framing and position on the canvas, and the same flat solid pure green #00FF00 background edge to edge.
Avoid: any new elements, text, glow, shadow, or background change.

characters.head:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single boss sprite for a vertical Space Invaders style arcade shooter, the boss's second form after it transforms mid-fight. It will be shown small, so it must read at low resolution.
Reference images: the first attached image is the current in-game pixel sprite of the boss 'Crimson Seraph', enlarged. It defines her identity: keep the same face, eye shape, hair color and hairstyle, head size, body proportions, pose and position on the canvas. The second attached image is the detailed source drawing of that same sprite; use it for line quality, shading and palette. Redraw her as her transformed second form, one standalone sprite in exactly this style.
characters.request:
Primary request: 'Crimson Seraph, Ascended', the enraged ascended form of the same chibi angel mecha girl. Clearly the same girl, clearly far more powerful. Same long pale pink hair, same face, now with eyes glowing bright gold-red (drawn with solid bright pixels) and a fierce determined expression. Her red halo is now cracked into jagged segments yet still one solid pixel ring, blazing bright gold and crimson. Her gold crown crest is taller and sharper. Her wings are doubled: two full pairs of huge mechanical blade-feather wings, an upper pair and a lower pair stacked on each side, the blade feathers now burning with hard-edged crimson and gold pixel flame tongues along their edges. Her armor is more ornate: heavier gold filigree, ruby gems, and bright glowing gold-orange seams drawn as solid pixel lines between the plates. Her head and body stay the same size and in the same place as in the reference; the extra wings grow outward into the margin. Outfit must stay fully modest: the same solid high-collared breastplate covering her from the neck down, no cutout, no window, no cleavage; the long armored skirt of overlapping plates down to armored boots, no bare thighs, no leotard, no bare midriff. Only her face and hands show skin. Arms open, floating, symmetric, wider than tall.
Glow rule: every glow, flame and blaze is drawn only as solid bright pixel colors inside the dark outline, with hard edges. No soft bloom, no light halo spilling onto the background, no detached embers, sparks or floating particles.
Color palette: crimson red, deep blood red, white and pale pink, bright gold and orange-gold flame, ruby gems, black joints, peach skin, dark outline. No green anywhere on the sprite.

characters.request:
Primary request: 'Void Empress, Eclipse', the darker, more powerful second form of the same chibi empress girl. Clearly the same girl, clearly more powerful. Same very long flowing lavender hair, same face, now with eyes glowing bright violet (drawn with solid bright pixels) and a cold commanding expression. Her spiky crown becomes a black eclipse sun: a solid black disc behind and above her head ringed by a bright corona of sharp gold and white pixel spikes. Her thin purple halo becomes a dark ring dotted with small bright white and gold pixel stars. Her gown becomes a living starfield: deep black-indigo void fabric filled with tiny white, lavender and gold star pixels and small violet nebula patches, with bright violet edge highlights along every fold so the dark gown stays readable on a dark navy screen. Her hem breaks into solid opaque pixel tatters and star-shard points, fully opaque, no fading. Instead of two orbs, four black-hole orbs float around her, two on each side, each a solid black sphere with a bright violet and gold accretion ring around it, attached to her by thin gold chains so they touch the sprite. Her head and body stay the same size and in the same place as in the reference. Outfit must stay fully modest: a closed high-necked gown whose solid bodice covers her from the collar down, no neckline opening, no cutout, no cleavage, no slit; long wide sleeves; the skirt is one continuous closed panel to the hem. Only her face and hands show skin. Arms open, floating, symmetric, roughly as wide as tall.
Glow rule: every glow is drawn only as solid bright pixel colors inside the dark outline, with hard edges. No soft bloom, no light halo spilling onto the background, no detached stars, sparks or floating particles outside the silhouette.
Color palette: black, deep indigo, deep purple, bright violet, lavender, white, gold trim, peach skin, dark outline. No green anywhere on the sprite.

characters.head:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single boss sprite for a vertical Space Invaders style arcade shooter: the boss's second form, her true-form reveal after she transforms mid-fight. It will be shown small, so it must read at low resolution.
Reference images: the first attached image is the boss 'Crimson Seraph' in her first form (a chibi pixel sprite, enlarged). Keep her identity from it: hair color and hairstyle, eye color, color scheme, armor and costume motifs. The second attached image is an earlier draft of her second form 'Crimson Seraph, Ascended'; take the transformed design elements from it. Do NOT copy the chibi proportions of either reference: in this true form she is a tall adult woman.
characters.style: Style/medium: detailed high-quality pixel art in the same palette, shading and line quality as the references: crisp hard-edged square pixels, clean dark outline around the whole silhouette, saturated colors. Anime-style but NOT chibi and NOT super-deformed: realistic adult proportions, about 6.5 heads tall, long legs, a mature beautiful adult face with narrower almond-shaped eyes. She must clearly look like a grown woman in her late twenties, never young or childlike.
characters.request:
Primary request: 'Crimson Seraph, Ascended', the true form of the crimson angel mecha boss: a tall, glamorous adult woman, a confident femme fatale villainess with a calm, alluring, slightly smug expression and glowing gold-red eyes (drawn with solid bright pixels). Long pale pink hair flowing out dramatically to both sides. Her red halo is cracked into jagged segments yet still one solid pixel ring, blazing gold and crimson, above her head, with her tall gold crown crest. Two full pairs of huge mechanical blade-feather wings, an upper pair and a lower pair spread wide on each side, the red and white blade feathers burning with hard-edged crimson and gold pixel flame tongues along their edges.
Outfit, elegant and PG-13: a fitted crimson-and-gold armored corset-style breastplate with a high neckline that fully covers the chest, ornate gold filigree and glowing gold-orange seams between the plates; bare shoulders and long red armored gauntlets; a flowing red-and-white armored skirt with a high side slit; thigh-high red armored boots. No cleavage window, no exposed midriff, no lingerie or swimsuit look.
Pose: floating upright, front-facing, elegant and commanding, arms held open and slightly out to the sides with open hands, legs together with one knee slightly bent. Roughly symmetric. The whole figure, wings included, is about as wide as it is tall.
Glow rule: every glow, flame and blaze is drawn only as solid bright pixel colors inside the dark outline, with hard edges. No soft bloom, no light halo spilling onto the background, no detached embers, sparks or floating particles.
Color palette: crimson red, deep blood red, white and pale pink, bright gold and orange-gold flame, ruby gems, black joints, peach skin, dark outline. No green anywhere on the sprite.
